objective: Remove repeated bearer-token prompts through a durable same-origin HttpOnly signed device session while preserving Bearer API access, localize the complete PWA and future deadline notifications into Russian, and improve the mobile System HUD without changing player-state authority or gameplay rules.

roles_before.artifact: SYSTEM_BEARER_TOKEN authorizes every /api route through a timing-safe Authorization: Bearer comparison.
The PWA keeps the raw bearer token in sessionStorage, so closing the browser loses connectivity and JavaScript can read the token.
ChatGPT and other authorized non-browser clients can use the Bearer header.
Bearer headers are not sent automatically by browsers and existing writes remain gated by authentication plus model/database validation.
Neon system_events remains the sole mutable owner of derived RPG state; the PWA is a projection.
Most PWA labels, statuses, errors and deadline messages are English despite Russian being Ron's primary language.
Opted-in Web Push uses the same notification event payload and must remain functional across service-worker upgrades.
The service worker caches the static shell and upgrades cache versions without changing authoritative state.
The prior Bearer-only API and English UI remain recoverable from Git history and deployment rollback.
UI/auth deployments must not create, reward, complete, cancel, fail or otherwise mutate quests/profile state.

role_dispositions.destination: API accepts either the unchanged timing-safe Bearer header or a signed expiring HttpOnly SameSite=Strict device-session cookie minted only after exact bearer verification.
The PWA exchanges the bearer once for an HttpOnly cookie, clears legacy sessionStorage after migration, and never persists the raw token in JavaScript storage.
Authorization: Bearer remains supported for ChatGPT/controller and automation clients.
Cookie-authenticated non-GET requests require same-origin Origin plus a PWA-only custom header; SameSite=Strict prevents ambient cross-site use.
No gameplay owner, projection semantics, event type or write action changes.
All visible static/dynamic UI text, known statuses, dates, errors and future deadline notifications render in Russian while canonical stored enum values remain unchanged.
Existing subscription and delivery tables/endpoints remain; the service worker cache advances and continues to display Russian/legacy notifications.
The same network-first shell caching model remains with an incremented cache version.
No existing secret, event or schema is rewritten; rollback to the base SHA restores the previous behavior.
Session/localization/HUD code has no call path to /api/v1/actions and production verification requires unchanged event and progression counts.

capability_probes.assertion: Valid Bearer requests still succeed and invalid Bearer requests still fail.
After session exchange the raw bearer is absent from localStorage/sessionStorage and the session cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Strict.
A cookie-authenticated non-GET request with a foreign/missing Origin or missing PWA client header is rejected.
Quest/profile/skill/shop/achievement projection and action-gate tests remain unchanged and passing.
The base implementation and prior UI remain available by Git/deployment rollback; no database migration is required.

tests.expected: PASS: login mints a signed expiring cookie, cookie authenticates reads, logout clears it, tampering/expiry fail, and Bearer stays valid.
PASS: cookie writes require same-origin Origin and X-System-Client while Bearer controller writes remain compatible.
PASS: Russian document metadata, navigation, states, dialogs, push controls and deadline messages contain no user-facing English fallback.
PASS: responsive primary quest/countdown, readable Russian attributes, connection state and critical notification treatment.
